verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an accounting SaaS that handles financial data and an AI assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers retention periods, deletion of data, or controls over what Command retains. The items describe bookkeeping, integrations, AI features and pricing, none of which relate to retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
